<function name="LookupPoseParameter" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns pose parameter ID from its name.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<added>2020.03.17</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">Pose parameter name</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The ID of the given pose parameter name, if it exists, -1 otherwise</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
